title: Dumped at the altar, then fully booked
description: Nate's bride screams 'Hell no' at the altar and leaves with a richer man. Her reselling-hustle montage becomes Nate trading on fomo, from a red day to a $742,900 balance, and when she finds him two years later in his penthouse he's fully booked. The live-action tag at the end becomes Nate saying fomo's end line.
text:
SCENE 1 — EXT. CLIFFTOP ALTAR BY THE OCEAN — DAY
Nate, in a navy wedding suit, faces Mara under the flower arch; Grant, in a cream linen suit, sits among the guests.
NATE: I do.
Mara leans into Nate's face and screams.
MARA: HELL NO!
Nate's face goes blank. Mara yanks off her ring and flicks it away; it bounces on the marble by Nate's shoes.
The guests gasp, hands over their mouths.
Mara points down the aisle at Grant, who smirks.
MARA: I'm marrying him!
Nate grimaces, teeth clenched.
NATE: What?!
Mara takes Grant's arm; they get into a white luxury car and drive off, leaving the driveway empty.
Nate stands alone under the arch, head bowed, then kneels and picks up the ring. He slips it onto his finger; it glints.
SCENE 2 — FLASHBACK — INT. LIVING ROOM — EVENING
Warm hazy glow: Nate and Mara on a couch, holding hands; she looks up at him, then rests her head on his shoulder.
MARA: I can't wait to spend forever with you.
SCENE 3 — EXT. CLIFFTOP ALTAR BY THE OCEAN — DAY
Nate alone at the arch, staring down at the ring on his hand as her words echo; slow push in.
MARA (V.O.): Forever with you.
MARA (V.O.): Forever with you.
MARA (V.O.): Forever with you.
Nate's jaw sets.
SCENE 4 — MONTAGE — NATE'S BEDROOM, THEN BIGGER ROOMS — NIGHTS
Nate, cap backwards, alone at a small bedroom desk at night, picks up his phone; his face lights blue.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, a red day, his thumb hovering over Sell
Nate pulls his thumb back, drops his forehead onto the desk, then sits back up.
Another night: the wall clock reads 3 a.m., Nate hunched over his phone, cold noodles beside him.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, his first small win, the position reads +$46 (+3.2%)
A tiny fist pump, then straight back to the charts.
Match cut, same pose: rain on the window, Nate rubbing his eyes, still trading.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $3,180
Match cut, same pose, bigger world: a better desk in a bigger flat, sunrise behind him, Nate leaning in.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $27,400
Match cut, same pose: a glass office high above the city, Nate grips the phone, eyes wide.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $742,900
Nate looks up from the phone with a slow smirk.
Nate walks toward camera as the world behind him swaps in match cuts: the small bedroom, the bigger flat, the glass office.
A dealer drops the keys of a glossy red sports car into Nate's palm; he slides behind the wheel, grinning.
Nate, now in an all-black suit, pushes through his penthouse's glass doors, crosses the room and stops at the balcony rail over the night skyline, chin up.
SCENE 5 — INT. PENTHOUSE PARTY — NIGHT — TWO YEARS LATER
Mara, on Grant's arm at a penthouse party, spots someone across the room and does a double take; Grant's jaw drops. Snap push in on her face.
MARA: Nate? Nate?
MARA: Huh?!
Nate leans on the glass wall in his black suit as glamorous women gather around him; slow push in on his smug smile.
NATE: Sorry, I'm fully booked.
Nate turns to camera with a small smirk and holds up his phone.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone held to camera, the balance reads $742,900
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.

cast.description: Mid-20s, slim, warm-brown skin, big glossy brown eyes, thick dark brows, dark curly hair. At the altar: navy wedding suit, white boutonniere. In the grind: navy cap worn backwards, plain oversized white tee, thin silver chain, dark joggers, white sneakers. After the rise: all-black suit over a black knit tee, heavier silver chain, no cap.

Young woman, straight shoulder-length black hair with blunt bangs, winged eyeliner, black lipstick, studded black choker, black fitted mini dress with sheer black lace bell sleeves, black patterned tights, chunky black lace-up boots. Same look in every scene.
30s, tall and broad, square jaw, slicked-back dark hair, smug half-lidded eyes; cream linen suit, open-collar white shirt, chunky gold watch, tan loafers.
